# Copilot Instructions

This repository is an AI Frontend internship project built with Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, npm, and Vercel.

## Project Conventions

- Use TypeScript throughout the application.
- Use Server Components by default.
- Use Client Components only when interactivity requires them.
- Prefer simple, maintainable solutions over unnecessary abstractions.
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling.
- Follow semantic HTML and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility principles.
- Ensure interfaces are responsive at 375px and 1280px.
- Never expose or commit secrets, API keys, or credentials.
- Validate external or API data before using it.
- Handle loading, error, empty, and failure states explicitly.
- Keep AI and LLM integrations structured, safe, and easy to test.
- Write tests for important behavior.
- Do not modify unrelated files when implementing a feature.
- Do not make architectural changes without explaining the reason first.
